message.content: {"type":"json_object","hypothesis":{"conditions":"Public runtime error (IndexError) occurs when the greedy loop pops from an empty heap because the code iterates m from n-1 down to 0 and requires have >= i, but voters with m_i >= i are never counted as already having votes; the heap can be empty while have < i.","action":"REPAIR_EXISTING","expected_improvement":"Replace the reverse greedy with the standard approach: sort voters by m_i descending, maintain a min-heap of p_i for voters with m_i >= current required count, and buy the cheapest votes until the number of acquired voters reaches the threshold, avoiding empty-heap pops.","refusal_conditions":"Do not claim certified root cause or hidden correctness; only fix the observable IndexError and verify against the public example.","stop_conditions":"Stop after producing a repaired solution that passes the public example (8,0,7) or after exhausting the single remaining call.","unknowns":"Whether the repaired greedy is fully correct for all constraints; only public example is verified."},"rule":{"when":{"candidate_state":"STRUCTURAL_PASS","public_result":"RUNTIME_ERROR","remaining_calls_min":1},"action":"REPAIR_EXISTING","fallback":"NATIVE"}}
